source.note: #1199's decision record (`ai-review-chain-roles-decision.md`, merged as PR #1203) supplies these roles, superseding the 2026-06 seeded values below. The current degraded-stack caps (CodeRabbit's burst limit, BugBot's spend exhaustion, Greptile's flex overage) are intentionally left out of `expected_caps` so the first post-swap audit run reports them as genuine drift rather than suppressing it.

tools.notes: Primary finder per the #1199 decision record: Pro, 3/3 seats, $90/mo as last measured 2026-08-21. The owner has since decided to cut the unused third seat (3 -> 2, then annual: $90/mo -> $48/mo, #1213/#1228) but has not yet made the change, so this stays at the measured value on purpose — an audit that reads 2/2 seats should report it as landed drift, not match a baseline written ahead of the click. gates_merge stays false — it never issues APPROVED, so marking it as gating would fire a permanent, false D4 every run. 22% of PRs reviewed and 68% of reviews rate-limited at a 5/hr per-developer burst (87.4h average wait) are measured facts, not baseline drift; expected_caps is deliberately empty so the first post-swap run reports the burst limit as genuine D3.

Primary approver (co-primary on the CR path) per the #1199 decision record: Premium, 2/2 seats, ~$48/mo — now paid, not trial. Sole source of APPROVED (360 approvals on 184 PRs), so gates_merge is true and approves_via is "review". The subscription-identity warning is confirmed non-blocking (org `Auto Approve PR` is ON), so not_subscribed stays an expected cap rather than news.

First fallback per the #1199 decision record: the stack's largest cost line — ~$1.58/review on-demand, $815.58 in one cycle against a $1,000 cap it has exhausted, refusing 64% of PRs. gates_merge is true — a clean BugBot pass on current HEAD satisfies the merge gate alone on its path — but approves_via stays "check_run", because it signals that pass through the `Cursor Bugbot` check-run and posts no APPROVED review object. Driving D4 off gates_merge would flag that as a missing approval every single run. expected_caps is empty so the current spend exhaustion surfaces as genuine D3 drift.

Second fallback — retained; a vendor-side spend cap is the intended control but is NOT yet configured, per the #1199 decision record: paid Pro on the `auerbachb` org with flex overage UNCAPPED (roughly $36-72/mo, 42 of 92 credits already on flex 15 days in). CONTESTED (#1213, #1228): the owner reports Greptile is now on the free tier and not being paid for, which the same-day #1204 round-2 reading contradicts; `billed` stays "paid" because that is the last actually-measured value, so a free/canceled reading surfaces as drift instead of being pre-agreed here. Settle it from `app.greptile.com/auerbachb/-/settings/billing` before treating either state as fact. Promoted out of dormant: highest unique yield in the chain (41 sole-source PRs), and the Greptile path is sticky on history once triggered. gates_merge is true on its path; approves_via is none because it signals through issue-comment reactions and severity classification, never a formal APPROVED review object. expected_caps is empty so the current flex-overage exposure surfaces as genuine D3 drift rather than being pre-suppressed.

Supplemental — paid, under re-measurement, per the #1199 decision record: newly paid Team plan (started 2026-08-07), measured almost entirely before the payment (1 sole-source PR in 244). Not promoted to a gating tier: it concludes success on nearly every PR and comments on only 4% of them, which would manufacture approvals (#875) if gated on. The re-measure trigger (at least 30 PRs merged under the paid plan) is already met at 88 PRs (7-21 Aug 2026), so the next audit should re-decide its role on paid evidence.

Zero activity under any login in the 2026-06 window. This repo is agent configuration, not a Vercel app. Kept disabled / Vercel-only. The #1199 decision record does not cover Vercel, so this entry is unchanged by the swap.
